values.note: Every site has water and electric hookups; the park does not state the amperage.

hookups.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/dreher-island/camping ('Each site has water and electrical hook-ups and a picnic table'; 'Standard Sites with Elec. & Water: 97 sites'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 97 paved RV/tent sites in two lakefront camping areas, plus 15 tent-only sites and a primitive group area. Many sites take RVs up to 45 ft, others up to 30 ft.

sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/dreher-island/camping ('Two lakefront camping areas ... Ninety-seven paved sites may be used by both RVs and tents, while 15 sites are for tent campers only'; 'Many sites accommodate RVs up to 45 feet, others up to 30 feet'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/dreher-island/camping ('All sites are convenient to hot showers and restrooms'; 'Dump Station: Yes'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; per the --AWH note, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum stay 14 nights (42 of 49 cumulative, shorter at busy parks in peak season). Same-day reservations go through the park. Check-in 2 pm at the Tackle Shop, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/dreher-island/camping ('Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; same-day via the park) + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/dreher-island/campsites (policies: 'Reservations may be made up to 13 months in advance', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 nights. Minimum length of stay is 2 nights'), read 2026-10-21; single-night waiver from the entry's --AWH note

summary: Confirmed reservable on SC's own site, 13-month window and 2-night minimum (now on the entry with the AWH phone waiver); added water at every site (amps not stated), 97 RV/tent sites up to 45 ft, 14-night max, showers and dump. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note kept. Not stated: amperage, sewer, season, pull-throughs.
